long_biography.plain_text:
Gruppo Toscano grew from Rome into a national property network by combining directly operated agencies with franchising. Ilario Toscano used television and print advertising early, built a shared operating method, and launched the franchise channel in 1997. The structure allowed local agencies to remain independent while drawing on central training and marketing.

Professional education became another part of Toscano's work. The group created its own academy and digital learning platform, while he helped establish the national agents' association ANAMA and later served as its honorary president. He also wrote Per fare impresa, a management book built around the company's experience, and received a career award after more than four decades in property services.
